Camera Feed

Intel RealSense camera interface for capturing color frames and depth maps.

Camera Feed Module.

This module provides an interface to Intel RealSense cameras for capturing color images and depth maps. It supports both live camera feeds and playback from recorded .bag files.

The module uses a global singleton pattern for easy access across the project, with setup/teardown functions and a RealSenseCam class that handles the pyrealsense2 pipeline configuration and frame alignment.

class camera_feed.RealSenseCam(recording_path=None, resolution=(640, 480), fps=30)[source]

Bases: object

Intel RealSense camera interface.

Manages the RealSense pipeline for capturing aligned color and depth frames. Supports both live camera streaming and playback from recorded .bag files.

RealSense pipeline for frame capture.

Type:

Pipeline configuration.

Type:

rs.config

profile

Active pipeline profile after start.

Type:

rs.pipeline_profile

align

Frame alignment object to align depth to color.

Type:

rs.align

__init__(recording_path=None, resolution=(640, 480), fps=30)[source]

Initialise RealSense camera.

Parameters:

  • recording_path (str, optional) – Path to .bag file for playback. If None, uses live camera feed.

  • resolution (tuple[int, int], optional) – Camera resolution as (width, height). Defaults to (640, 480).

  • fps (int, optional) – Frame rate in frames per second. Defaults to 30.

get_frames()[source]

Get next frame set from the camera.

Retrieves the next available frameset and aligns depth to color.

Returns:

(aligned_frames, success) where:

  • aligned_frames (rs.composite_frame): Aligned frameset, or None if failed

  • success (bool): True if frames retrieved successfully, False otherwise

Return type:

tuple
